query:
UPDATE job_executions AS je
               SET execute_at = LEAST(je.execute_at, $2)
             WHERE je.id = ANY($1)
               AND je.state = 'pending'
               AND je.attempt_index <= 1
               AND je.execute_at > $2
            RETURNING je.id AS "id!: JobId", je.job_type AS "job_type!: JobType"
